assumptions.title: Poisson long-horizon encounter process
assumptions.statement: Encounter frequency over long horizons is approximated by a Poisson process.
assumptions.rationale: Provides a first-order arrival-process baseline for Monte Carlo studies.

assumptions.title: Log-normal relative velocity shape
assumptions.statement: Relative velocity distribution is approximated as log-normal in sparse-data regimes.
assumptions.rationale: Captures a heavy upper tail without enforcing symmetry.

assumptions.title: Inverse-square detection scaling
assumptions.statement: Detection horizon scales with inverse-square signal decay as a sensitivity proxy.
assumptions.rationale: First-order radiative dilution model for range scaling.

assumptions.title: Independent observation windows
assumptions.statement: Observation windows across campaigns are treated as independent.
assumptions.rationale: Keeps uncertainty propagation additive in the baseline envelope.

assumptions.title: Solar irradiance baseline at 1 AU
assumptions.statement: Solar constant is fixed at 1361 W/m^2 for envelope calculations.
assumptions.rationale: Establishes deterministic scaling for perihelion radiative load checks.

assumptions.title: Reference compact object mass
assumptions.statement: Reference compact-object mass for scaling is set to 10 solar masses.
assumptions.rationale: Anchors the Schwarzschild-radius scale statement used throughout the whitepaper.

assumptions.title: Two-body heliocentric closure
assumptions.statement: Solar Oberth scale checks use two-body heliocentric dynamics with fixed solar GM.
assumptions.rationale: Provides a transparent first-order energy closure before high-fidelity trajectory work.

assumptions.title: Impulsive perihelion burn approximation
assumptions.statement: SRM burn is modeled as an impulsive prograde delta-v at perihelion.
assumptions.rationale: Supports clear velocity-envelope calculations for q and delta-v ranges.

assumptions.title: Near-parabolic inbound baseline
assumptions.statement: Baseline speed envelope assumes inbound v_infinity approximately zero.
assumptions.rationale: Separates baseline claim from conditional high-energy architectures.

assumptions.title: Conditional inbound energy uplift
assumptions.statement: Conditional 35-45 km/s envelope is evaluated for inbound v_infinity in 10-30 km/s range.
assumptions.rationale: Makes high-end speed claims explicit and testable as conditional assumptions.

assumptions.title: Small-angle transverse leverage linearization
assumptions.statement: Cross-track correction scale uses linearized relation delta_perp ~= (delta_v_perp / v_infinity) * D.
assumptions.rationale: Appropriate first-order approximation when interaction radius is much smaller than distance.

assumptions.title: Reference distance anchor
assumptions.statement: Distance anchor for scale checks is fixed at 1560 light-years.
assumptions.rationale: Keeps delta-v leverage and time-of-flight calculations comparable across sections.

assumptions.title: Radioactive-only RTG decay envelope
assumptions.statement: First-order RTG decay uses Pu-238 half-life of 87.7 years.
assumptions.rationale: Captures lower-bound power decay independent of mechanical degradation modes.

assumptions.title: Cost classes are order-of-magnitude anchors
assumptions.statement: Archive-only and flagship cost figures are treated as O(10^8) and O(10^9) class anchors.
assumptions.rationale: Represents framing-level placeholders pending full WBS and vendor-backed estimation.

assumptions.title: Hypervelocity validation window for ground tests
assumptions.statement: Ground test closure is limited to a facility-relevant hypervelocity regime, with higher-relative-speed cases treated as extrapolation risk.
assumptions.rationale: Separates validated regime from extrapolated high-relative-speed environment cases.
